original_test_intent: Verify that the active GPU firmware bundle on the intended platform is uniquely identified and reports exactly version 24.06.
original_method: Retrieve exact bundle_active from a trusted read-only Redfish session, retain minimal redacted identity/version evidence, normalize according to the approved semantic rule and assert equality to 24.06.

required_inputs: Trusted BMC/Redfish endpoint/certificate and network path
Expected literal bundle version 24.06 and normalization rule
safety_requirements: Use exact read-only resource and least privilege

Stop on trust/auth/duplicate/missing/malformed/version mismatch or audit error

Do not interpret latest, accept substrings, mutate firmware or decide PASS/FAIL

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The broad trust-disabled inventory neither selects bundle_active nor proves exact 24.06 equality and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query exact bundle_active over verified HTTPS with brokered read-only access and compare its unique active version semantically to literal 24.06.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: bundle_active identity, exact 24.06 expectation and source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store a concise assertion containing verified platform/BMC, bundle member ID, active state, raw/normalized version, expected 24.06 and equality result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures the lookup and makes the previously implicit exact comparison executable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Component-version agreement is not substituted for the bundle record.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Formatting such as 24.06.0 or vendor suffixes requires an explicitly approved normalization rule rather than substring matching.

project_override_considerations: Changing the required bundle version needs an approved source decision; the reviewer must not replace 24.06 with whatever version is currently reported.
expected_evidence: Exact bundle_active URI/status/time and redacted fields
Unique active bundle raw and normalized version

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, URI and Criteria consistently target active bundle version 24.06; secure access and normalization are implementation inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Trust, access and schema inputs can be supplied; static review is complete without claiming the observed version.

review_improvement: Upgrades a broad manual inventory diff into a trusted exact bundle-member assertion with explicit semantic equality to 24.06.
independent_technical_reasoning: An active component set can contain versions that resemble the bundle label, but only bundle_active represents the release bundle as a whole. Exact parsing matters because substring 24.06 could match a build identifier or later release. Evidence must preserve the raw value and the approved normalization before equality is evaluated.
